items.title: Mahindra XUV 3XO crosses 500,000 sales ahead of new CNG model launch
items.summary: The XUV 3XO is the latest model from the Mumbai-based Mahindra & Mahindra to achieve the 500,000 domestic market wholesales milestone. This total comprises sales of the XUV300 launched in April 2024 , the rebranded model XUV 3XO introduced in April 2024, and the XUV 3XO EV unveiled in January 2026.
